_comment: Internal Unreal class-name codename -> real VALORANT weapon name/category. NOT fetched from valorant-api.com (which has no internal-name field) -- this is vrfkit's OWN generated mapping (tools/equippable_table.py, itself generated from a companion C# replay parser's hand-maintained table, ValorantEquippableResolver.cs), copied in here as a small static table the same way agents.json holds a copy of valorant-api's agent-id table. 'codename' is the substring to look for anywhere in an actor's class_path/archetype_path (matching WeaponCatalog.Resolve's substring approach, the same technique UtilityEffectClassifier already uses for ability class paths) -- not an exact full path, since vrfkit's path formatting could vary slightly by build. Confirmed by a research pass reading vrfkit's source directly, cross-checked against valorant-api.com's own assetPath field for several weapons; NOT independently confirmed by this project against a real decoded export.
